title: Proper hypercover descent for nearby cycles
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian, $f:X\to S$ of finite presentation, and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring killed by an integer invertible on $S$. Let $\epsilon:Y_\bullet\to X$ be an augmented simplicial scheme whose augmentation and simplicial matching maps are proper surjective, with every $Y_i$ of finite presentation over $S$. For $K\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ with $H^j(K)=0$ for $j<c$, put $f_i=f\epsilon_i$ and $K_i=\epsilon_i^*K$, and write $\bar\epsilon_i:V_{f_i}\to V_f$ for the induced maps. In the notation of [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles] there is a cohomological descent spectral sequence $E_1^{i,j}=H^j(R\bar\epsilon_{i,*}R\Psi_{f_i}K_i)\Longrightarrow H^{i+j}(R\Psi_fK)$, with $i\geq0$ and $j\geq c$. For each total degree $n$, the abutment has a finite filtration whose associated graded sheaves are the $E_\infty^{i,n-i}$ for $0\leq i\leq n-c$. The spectral sequence and its augmentation are natural for base changes of $S$.

source.place: Section 9.2, printed p. 22, displayed proper-hypercover descent identity and associated spectral sequence.
